text: The authors describe Bowman et al.'s sandwiching evaluation and say that, like Bowman et al., they study a simplified sandwiching setting that replaces the expert group with fixed ground-truth labels. They differ by using LLMs instead of the weaker group of humans, to reduce cost and speed iteration.
title: Kenton et al. adapt Bowman et al.'s simplified sandwiching, replacing weak human groups with LLM judges
